nodes.label: Chained-setter component API
nodes.rationale: Primitives model a chained-setter API on Obsidian's ButtonComponent (constructor takes parentEl, root exposed as .el) and must import nothing from store/ or main. Extend an existing primitive with a new setter/variant instead of adding one-off elements; new primitives must update the styleguide and StyleguideView together.

nodes.label: UI layering: primitives / composites / orchestrators
nodes.rationale: Composites take resolved data + callbacks via props only - no plugin, no store, no onRefresh; if a composite needs plugin, store access must be pushed up to the orchestrator view. Layer rules (what each may import) live in CLAUDE.md under UI layers.
